svg.title: Feature encoding of a steam.csv row
svg.text: Real example: Stardew Valley (held-out test row). Lit cells are non-zero values seen by the model.
Binary flags use case-insensitive substring matching (pandas str.contains): "Partial Controller Support" does not set
cat_full_controller_support, while "Multi-player" sets cat_multi_player. Developer: 2 counts + 20 one-hot flags for the most prolific studios.
